02 · Marquee Client

Executive Office
of the President

From 2017 to 2025, WDG served as a trusted digital partner to the White House, supporting whitehouse.gov across two administrations. Our work spanned information architecture, design, development, and project management for one of the most visible websites in the world.

WDG also served as partner liaison supporting digital platforms and tools to enhance communication efforts for the Biden-Harris White House.

04 · CMS Migration

The Ford Foundation

Known for its global grant-making influence, the Ford Foundation is passionate about the pursuit of human dignity worldwide. WDG migrated its public-facing site from Umbraco into WordPress Gutenberg, applying a revised brand refresh and streamlining the editorial experience.

Migration path
Umbraco → WordPress Gutenberg
★2024 Webby Award Nominee
How we migrated
01Connected to SQL server, importing titles, authors, URLs, body text, publication dates, abstracts, and taxonomy
02Applied revised brand guidelines across design with full accessibility compliance
03Rebuilt features in WordPress Gutenberg with visual editing replacing the classic editor
04Shipped streamlined publishing tools giving editors direct visual feedback during content creation

CMS Migration

01 · CMS Migration
From legacy systems
to WordPress at scale.
Every migration starts with understanding content architecture, not just the data. WDG has migrated Drupal, Umbraco, and proprietary headless platforms to WordPress Gutenberg, preserving structured content, taxonomy, and editorial workflows. We connect directly to source databases, rebuild block systems, and ship platforms editors actually want to use. Featured work: Ford Foundation, NLC, World Central Kitchen.

Member experiences

For associations and policy organizations, identity is infrastructure. WDG has implemented SSO solutions, member portals with personalization, saved resources, and governance models that give the right people access to the right content. Search & Discovery
04
Search & Discovery
SOLR-powered dynamic filtering for large content libraries. Resources, policy content, and taxonomy at scale.
04 · Search & Discovery
Content libraries
people can actually find.
Large policy and resource libraries are only as useful as their search. WDG implemented SOLR-powered dynamic filtering for NLC's Resource Library, enabling faceted search by city size, region, topic, program type, and audience. The result is a discovery experience that surfaces the right content for each user, reducing friction and increasing engagement across a complex content ecosystem.

05 · Integrations
Systems that talk
to each other.
Modern nonprofit and association operations run on multiple platforms. WDG connects them. For World Central Kitchen, we're integrating Salesforce, Classy, AirTable, and Mailgun directly into WordPress, unifying donor management, volunteer coordination, and communications into a single operational layer. We've also worked with AMS platforms ensuring data flows where it's needed without manual intervention.
